description: Election Commission - Local Authority Election - 2025 Notice under Section 66(B)(1) Names of Mayors, Deputy Mayors, Chairman and Vice Chairmen
categorisation: This gazette contains official declarations of election results for local government authorities, specifically announcing the names of Mayors, Deputy Mayors, Chairmen, and Vice Chairmen who have been declared appointed under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It falls under the Elections category as it deals with electoral processes and outcomes.
